nodes.label: JNI Android Bluetooth Detection
nodes.rationale: Uses ndk-context to obtain the JavaVM pointer, then calls BluetoothAdapter.getDefaultAdapter() and isEnabled() via JNI to detect real adapter state on Android. The SAFETY invariant is that ndk-context stores the pointer set by the Android runtime before any Rust code runs.
